contentHtml:
Looking to upgrade your bags, but are a little tight on gold? Here are some bag upgrades from quests in Forever that should give you a bit more storage space!

Bag Upgrade Guide


There are many items that players will want to carry while leveling in WoW: Forever. From consumables that replenish you before the next pull, to quest items that you have to carry around, to items you want to vendor to make some Gold, bag space is a premium, especially in the early levels.

 


At the start of a character's adventure, players can get 6-slot bags to expand their inventory in the starting area. With four 6-slot bags and the base 20 slots, this totals 42 slots. This sounds like a lot, but this space fills up very quickly when you're picking up everything to sell for money and finishing quests. Players will quickly look to expand their inventory space to carry more items on their adventures, but with competing gold costs on skill upgrades every two levels, and Dual Spec and Mount Training at level 40, gold might be tight.

There are random bags that can drop from any mob in the world, such as Large Blue Sack, but if you're looking for something a little more guaranteed, there are plenty of bags from quests and bosses. If you want to see a full list of bag upgrades, check out Wowhead's Bag Guide.

Bag Rewards from Quests

There are quite a few Bag rewards from quests in WoW: Forever, with four new quests rewarding players with bags in the earlier levels. Keep in mind, you might not be able to complete a quest solo right when you're eligible to pick it up; several quests pose quite a challenge if you're on your own.

contentHtml:
This week, while most players are still adventuring through the early levels, some have been exploring higher-level dungeons and looking out for signs of secrets and surprises that we found in Season of Discovery. In this case, SeventeenUncles has found that the area in Blackrock Depths that used to host a quest for the Rainbow Generator Toy now has a new Toy available.

Thank you to SeventeenUncles for providing the information in this article.



Traveler's Symbols
Item Level 60
Binds when picked up
Unique
Toy
Use: Place a Traveler's Sign that lasts for 1 min. A message can be written on the sign, causing it to last for 1 hour and making it visible to other players. (30 Min Cooldown)
Sell Price: 46 18



When you use this toy, you can choose from a list of things to put on your signpost, and it will remain in place for 1 hour, where other players will be able to see it.


 


And not only that, but you also get Student Fodder and Premo's Poise-Demanding Uniform in the same place. Premo's Poise-Demanding Uniform makes you turn to face your target on use. This shirt had a key role to play in the Seventeen & the Secret Agents Secret in Season of Discovery and will no doubt be key to many discoveries in Forever.





You find the platform just East of the Ring in Blackrock Depths. There is a bridge that leads North over the lava. While on the bridge, clear the mobs in front of you (Blazing Fireguards & Shadowforge Dwarves), then get ready for some parkour. Our guide goes through this in more detail, or we have a video below from SeventeenUncles.



WoW: Forever has been full of surprises and collectable items so far (and we aren't even two weeks in). If secret-finding is your thing, then join the hunt with the WoW Secret Finding Discord.

contentHtml:
In a brand-new change, dungeon mobs will now grant zero experience when the highest-level player is more than 12 levels above the creature, instead of when the mob is grey!

Many players were very critical of yesterday's dungeon experience change, with many reports across social media and the forums sharing their personal experience of how these changes affected them. Many players pointed how dungeons have a wide variety of mob levels, and how tanks and healers usually want to be overleveled for dungeons to make for easier dungeon runs, and how this change was excluding them from groups.

Blizzard has clearly heard this feedback, admitted they "missed the mark," and have made another change.
Blizzard
View Original
Yesterday, we updated dungeon play so that experience granted by an enemy in an instance is nullified if a high level player is in the group and enemy is trivial to that player. For some dungeons, the new restriction missed the mark because of the overall level range of the enemies in the dungeon.

With hotfixes that are now live, we’ve just deployed a further change to this restriction, making it so that the XP nullification only kicks in when the high-level player is more than 12 levels above the level of the enemies.

Please note that this adjustment will not apply in instances that were already underway when it was deployed (a few minutes ago).

Thank you very much!

contentHtml:
Krol'dok Stronghold is a new dungeon that challenges players in the Level 40-45 bracket in WoW: Forever - take a look at the quests and rewards you'll find inside!

Krol'dok Stronghold Dungeon Guide


Our dungeon guide has everything you'll need to tackle this dungeon: where to find it, boss strategies, notable trash, and more. Stay tuned for our Dungeon Journal tool to update as well!

New Dungeon: Krol'dok Stronghold

Krol'dok Stronghold is a level 40-45 Dungeon located in the new zone Riverglades. This is a very large dungeon, as players have infiltrated the capital city of the Krol'dok Ogres, assisted by the Twilight's Hammer and Shadowhide Gnoll Clan of Redridge.

  • 4-5 Quests forHorde and Alliance granting 10,000+ Experience each
  • 6 Bosses with powerful gear
  • Very strong Plate tank gearset
  • Can use mounts inside the dungeon
  • Extensive quest chains to unlock main dungeon quests

Krol'dok Stronghold Quests

There are a total of 5 quests for Alliance and 4 for Horde. Both have very long chain quests that start in their respective faction quest hubs. Both Horde and Alliance should make sure to have 12 Iron Bars and 4 Thick Leather for the quest: Key Ingredients.

Krol'dok Stronghold Bosses

Krol'dok Stronghold has a total of six bosses:
  1. Slavecrusher Grox: Calls for help from nearby Redridge Prisoners, and will use Bloodlust on himself and his prisoners.
  2. Twilight Commander Zarmok: Deals powerful AoE damage with Rending Whirl, and will Enrage when reaching 30% Health.
  3. War Handler Ashka: Accompanied by two Wolf companions, Ashka will sic her hounds on random party members with Command: Kill!.
  4. Nar'gurk: Surrounded by members of the Twilight's Hammer, He'll cast Shadow Bolt Volley on all party members and Convert a random player, needing them to be taken down to 50% Health to break the effect.
  5. Bossman Toof: This encounter is a series of add waves as you make your way to the boss. The boss himself is a warrior with the following abilities: Mortal Strike, Thunderclap, and Demoralizing Shout.
  6. Overlord Mugg: The ruler of Krol'dok Stronghold, Mugg is a weapon master who will swap between weapons with Mugg's Fury, start with Set of Maces, and move to Set of Mauls. He'll also jump to random party members with Crushing Slam, dealing damage and knocking them and anyone nearby back.

Krol'dok Stronghold Trash

The trash here continues to take a step up in power. Twilight Grunts are the most dangerous mobs in the dungeon. They have a very powerful AoE Bladestorm ability dealing damage to all players within 8 yards, and when more than one is present, this can quickly shred through party members' health!

summary.en: Dungeon Mobs Grant Zero Experience if Trivial to Anyone in Party in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Las criaturas de las mazmorras no dan nada de experiencia si son demasiado fáciles para alguien del grupo en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
In last night's hotfixes, Blizzard announced that if any party member in a dungeon is too high-level, no one in the party will receive experience.

Blizzard recently released a large set of hotfixes to dungeons, quests, NPCs, items, and more. These hotfixes had a change to dungeon experience, where if a mob is trivial to anyone in the group it will grant zero experience. Mobs turn grey when a player is too high-level and the mob is considered "trivial".

While dungeon experience is nerfed in WoW: Forever at 60% of the original values, all experience still helps you level up. Inviting a high-level player to a dungeon can now remove a decent chunk of raw experience points from mob kills across an entire dungeon.
Blizzard
View Original
Killing enemies in dungeons now awards zero experience to all party members if the level of the enemy is trivial to the level of one or more of the party members.
This can get complicated, as trash mobs are typically a couple of levels lower than bosses and many players want to be the appropriate level for them. Some dungeons have the level of trash increase as you progress, so there's potential for the trash to give no experience at the start, but will give experience later on. On the flip side, with quests giving the majority of experience in a dungeon, some players may be okay with inviting higher-level players still, as even if the mobs give no experience, they can complete the dungeon faster and turn in their quests faster.

contentHtml:
Players have discovered an additional bonus to equipping all of the new Krol'dok Battlegear armor from Krol'dok Stronghold in Forever: Turning the player into an Ogre!

Visit Reddit


One of the new dungeons in WoW: Forever, the Krol'dok Stronghold, has a new set of gear for Protection Warriors and Paladins with the Krol'dok Battlegear. Some pieces, such as the Krol'dok Warplate Pauldrons, are BoE, while others like the Krol'dok Warplate Helmet are BoP drops from bosses within the dungeon. When players acquire all 5 pieces, not only do they benefit from all the set bonuses, but they also transform into an Ogre after reaching the max stacks from the set bonus!

 


Blizzard has not only added new dungeon sets to Forever dungeons, such as Rotmender's Raiment from Ruins of Lordaeron or Violet Sorcerer's Vestments from the City of Dalaran, but has also updated Classic dungeon sets such as the Embrace of the Viper from Wailing Caverns. Leveling dungeon sets look to be more powerful and rewarding than they were in Classic WoW, and have been a very popular feature in WoW: Forever.

contentHtml:
Blizzard has posted hotfixes for today, which includes many fixes to dungeons, quests, enemies, and classes!

For Combat
  • Issues with Diminishing Returns not applying have been fixed.
  • Large number of class bug fixes and changes.
  • Many items has stats corrected.
For Leveling
  • Many quests had issues corrected.
For Everyday Players
  • More players are allowed to win the Stranglethorn Fishing event.
  • The Dual spec bug has been fixed.
  • Many enemies have been changed or fixed.
Blizzard
View Original
November 13, 2026

Classes
  • Fixed a bug causing players to have no diminishing returns against creature stuns.
  • Fixed a bug causing players to have no diminishing returns when using stuns against creatures.
  • Druid
    • Restoration
      • Fixed a bug incorrectly allowing Wild Growth to be cast while moving.
      • Wild Growth spell healing coefficient increased to 6.6% (was 3.3%).
  • Mage
    • Frost Nova is now correctly broken by damage from procs and damage from Blizzard.
  • Paladin
    • Judgement of Command now activates on-hit effects and counts as a melee attack.
    • Developers’ notes: All other judgements will continue to be considered Ranged attacks. This matches Command’s uniqueness across the Judgements, where it was the only one considered a Melee attack. All other seals were considered Spells, but in WoW: Forever they are being considered Ranged attacks.
  • Priest
    • The Legacy Perk The Quick and the Dead will now correctly reduce the Mana cost of Divine Spirit.
  • Shaman
    • Windfury Totem is now correctly activated by all melee abilities even if it doesn’t involve your main hand weapon.
      • Developers’ notes: Strikes from abilities that involve your offhand weapon like Whirlwind or Mutilate do not have a chance to activate Windfury. The main-hand strike from those abilities still does.
  • Warlock
    • Siphon Life Rank 1 can no longer be cast while silenced.
  • Warrior
    • Fixed an issue where Berserker Rage was not removing Sap.
Dungeons
  • Killing enemies in dungeons now awards zero experience to all party members if the level of the enemy is trivial to the level of one or more of the party members.
  • The Deadmines
    • Sneed should now properly eject if the Sneed’s Shredder is stunned when reaching 0% health.
  • The Drowned City
    • Non-boss enemies now respawn 2 hours after being killed (was 1 hour).
  • Stratholme
    • Defeating Balnazzar should now correctly count toward the Legacy Challenge Master Spelunker.
Enemies and NPCs
  • Gnomeregan - Techbot’s respawn time reduced for the quest “Save Techbot’s Brain!”
  • Badlands - Lesser Rock Elemental spawns should now appear more frequently.
  • Eastern Plaguelands - Fixed an issue that caused enemies to sometimes aggro unexpectedly in Stratholme and Eastern Plaguelands, particularly when resurrecting.
  • Mulgore - Quillboar spawning rates have been reduced in the starting area and should now be less aggressive.
  • Mulgore - Venture Co. spawn rates have been reduced in the starting area and should now be less aggressive.
  • Blasted Lands - Nethergarde Keep guards no longer drop loot and should have behavior consistent with other guards.
  • Stranglethorn Vale - Tiger, panther, and raptor spawns should now appear more frequently.
  • Zephras Isle - Nyalah Brightfire in Valanaar should now provide a more extensive array of cooking supplies for aspiring culinary artists.
Items
  • Gloves of Holy Might now have the correct text description. Gloves of Holy Might is now only activated by spells and abilities that are harmful and deal damage.
  • The Glimmering Mithril Insignia trinket no longer requires the ability to wear Mail armor.
  • Fixed an issue where Cloak of the Fleshborer had no texture.
  • Taran Icebreaker now correctly behaves as a 2-handed Mace (was incorrectly behaving as a 1-handed Mace).
  • Darkspear signet rings have had their Mp5 corrected and now match Alliance-equivalent rings.
  • Everstaring Abomination Eye’s Spirit stats corrected.
  • The Bad Hat no longer provides an incorrect amount of spell power.
  • The Souvenir Sea Shell’s stats have been corrected.
  • Blessed Band of Light’s Hit stat has been removed.
  • Channeler’s Ring now has Spell Power (was Spirit).
    • Developers’ notes: Players may exchange their Blessed Band of Light for a Channeler’s Ring if they wish to. Until raids open, this exchange will be the first item on Pix Xizzix’s vendor list if you have a Blessed Band of Light. This exchange cannot be reversed.
Quests
  • Fixed an issue during the quest “The Talisman of Kazdor” where rogues would enter the wrong version of Zul’Farrak.
  • Deadwood Key, Drop of Stolen Life, Ring of the Fallen Soldier, Venom-dripping heart, and Blackthorne Intelligence should now drop for all players in the party who have the associated quest(s).
  • On “A Quick Grocery Run”, Skonk’s list can be read by everyone.
  • Pix Xizzix’s weekly dungeon quests are now properly removed from the quest log on weekly reset.
  • When you’re “Coyote Huntin’”, Sootfur’s pelt should now be shared for all members of your party.
  • The Crow Effigy should now be visible if you meet the quest requirements to interact with it on Mount Hyjal.
  • Unstable Package should no longer have a chance to proc while on a taxi during “Crate Expectations” and the misfire damage has been reduced.
  • Fixed a bug that caused a player picking up the quest “Return to the Port” to delete nearby players’ quest items for “The Cook in the Cage”.
  • Doomguard Xarkul kill credit should now be granted to healers who assist Yashiro on “Yashiro’s Windwalk”.
  • Riverglades - Resolved an issue with Jezap Jinglesprocket refusing to offer quests to players attempting the Bloodmaster’s Ring.
  • Feralas - Fixed several issues during the quest “Gordunni Cobalt.”
  • Riverglades - “Gaseous Gold” now denotes the correct amount required for the quest.
  • Riverglades woodpiles are no longer lootable when not on the associated quests.
  • Undercity and Stormwind - Fixed an issue where Owen Thadd and Garion Wendell would refuse to accept any books. Our outstanding library fees have been paid and we’re all back in good standing!
Stranglethorn Fishing Extravaganza
  • Improved the weekly fishing tournament by greatly increasing the number of players per ruleset who can win.
    • Developers’ notes: We continue to work on performance issues with the tournament, and we will deploy additional fixes in the weeks to come.
User Interface
  • Fixed a bug that caused Action Bar settings to reset every time players who acquired Secondary Talents logged out of the game.
